notes: Two corrections. The article of הַיּוֹם at s034 takes the ASV's this, as its two counterparts in the same verse already do (rule 41); it had been marked unrepresented with this day folded onto the noun.
In בְּעֵינֶיךָ the pronoun thee realizes the suffix, not the noun עֵינֵי (rule 18); the accepted alignment had them the other way round, against the chapter's own treatment at 19.37 and 19.38.
